name: Card
title: Card
summary: Rounded content containers: the React `Card` (a large, image-led tile) and the website `.card` family for programs, text, values, people, contact, books, steps and statements.
whenToUse: React `Card`: immersive topic or testament tiles in the dot.Bible app and on dark marketing sections.
`.card`: any grouped, linkable block of content on the website.
whenNotToUse: Do not nest cards in cards. Do not use a card for a single line of text; use a ListRow.

anatomy.markup: Base: `.card` (white, 1px `--border-hairline-light`, 20px radius `--radius-lg`, 24px padding, `--shadow-card-light`, hover `--shadow-lift`). Photos sit in `.media` and zoom 3% on hover.

props.name: image
props.description: Photo URL. Without it the card is `--charcoal-900`.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text for the photo. Empty by default because the title names the card.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small uppercase label above the title.

props.name: cta
props.description: CTA pill label shown top-right, rendered "<Label> ↗". Pass `""` to hide it.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the card clickable. Renders `role="link"` with `tabIndex={0}` and Enter/Space handling.

react.notes: `import { Card, ContentCard, CardMedia, CardBody, CardCta } from '@ism/ui'` (source: `packages/react/src/components/Card.tsx`). `Card`: large, immersive, image-led card: full-bleed photo, dark gradient overlay for legibility, rounded corners, thin border, a white "Explore ↗" pill top-right, and title/eyebrow bottom-left. Used for testament/topic tiles across the dot.Bible app and marketing site. Styled inline; renders a `div` and forwards its ref. The website `.card` family:

props.name: image
props.description: Photo: a URL or an image source. Without it the card is `charcoal-900`.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text. Empty by default because the title names the card.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small uppercase label above the title.

props.name: cta
props.description: Label of the white CTA pill shown top-right, followed by ↗. Omit (or pass "") to hide the pill. Pass it in the UI language, e.g. "Explore".

props.name: GradientComponent
props.description:
Gradient view such as `LinearGradient`. Paints the dark bottom overlay (5% to 78% black). Without it a flat 40% black scrim
(`overlay-photo`) keeps the text legible.

variantNotes: `.card-flat` keeps the resting shadow on hover (for cards that are not links). Inside `.sec-ink`, cards turn translucent automatically.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Radius 20px (`--radius-lg`) for every card; media inside a flush card has square corners.
The whole card is the link (`<a class="card">`); do not add a second button inside a linked card.
Card CTAs are text with ↗ when they go to another page. The React CTA pill always reads "<Label> ↗".
Never use solid Horizon Blue inside a card except the book cover sample; blue stays for the page's primary button.
Use only real photography with people or the product; use `.ph` placeholders until a real photo exists.
Keep card grids to 3 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile, 24px gap (`--space-5`).
do: React `Card`: immersive topic or testament tiles in the dot.Bible app and on dark marketing sections.
`.card`: any grouped, linkable block of content on the website.
Radius 20px (`--radius-lg`) for every card; media inside a flush card has square corners.
The whole card is the link (`<a class="card">`); do not add a second button inside a linked card.
Card CTAs are text with ↗ when they go to another page. The React CTA pill always reads "<Label> ↗".
Use only real photography with people or the product; use `.ph` placeholders until a real photo exists.
Keep card grids to 3 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile, 24px gap (`--space-5`).
dont: Do not nest cards in cards. Do not use a card for a single line of text; use a ListRow.
Never use solid Horizon Blue inside a card except the book cover sample; blue stays for the page's primary button.
accessibility: Linked cards contain one heading; the link's accessible name comes from it. Keep CTA text short so the name stays readable.
Every photo has meaningful `alt`, or `alt=""` if decorative. Medallion icons are `aria-hidden`.
React `Card` with `onClick` is a `div` that gets `role="link"`, `tabIndex={0}` and Enter/Space handling. Give it a `title` so the link has a name. For a real URL, prefer `ContentCard` with `href`.
Text on the React Card always sits on the dark gradient overlay for contrast.
content: Titles name the thing: "dot.Bible App", "HD Radio Broadcast", "Global Bible Network", "The Old Testament".
One sentence of body copy, warm and plain: "Scripture readings on the air, wherever listeners tune in."
